# CampusLoop – Ghana University Campus Marketplace

> CampusLoop is Ghana's online university campus marketplace connecting buyers directly with verified student sellers and campus service providers across Ghanaian universities.

- **Official Website**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/
- **Marketplace Discovery**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/discover
- **Products Catalog**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/products
- **Services Directory**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/services
- **User Manual & Safety Guide**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/manual
- **Seller Sign Up / Login**: https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/auth

## What CampusLoop Does
CampusLoop makes it fast and safe for university students and campus communities in Ghana to buy, sell, and book products and services priced in Ghanaian Cedis (GH₵).

- **No Buyer Account Required**: Anyone can browse listings, filter by university, compare prices, bookmark favourites locally, and contact sellers directly via WhatsApp, phone call, or email without signing up.
- **Verified Campus Sellers**: Student sellers verify with a Student ID and matching real profile photo; non-student campus sellers verify with a Ghana Card or Voter's ID and matching face photo, reviewed and approved by platform admins before listing.
- **Direct Campus Meetups**: CampusLoop has no in-app checkout fee or escrow intermediary — buyers and sellers coordinate directly and are guided to meet in busy public campus areas.

## Supported Ghanaian Universities
CampusLoop supports campus-specific and cross-campus discovery across:
- KNUST (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Kumasi)
- University of Ghana (Legon, Accra)
- University of Cape Coast (UCC, Cape Coast)
- Central University (Miotso / Mataheko, Accra)
- UPSA (University of Professional Studies, Accra)
- UEW (University of Education, Winneba)
- UDS (University for Development Studies)
- UMaT (University of Mines and Technology, Tarkwa)
- UENR (University of Energy and Natural Resources, Sunyani)
- GCTU (Ghana Communication Technology University, Tesano)
- UHAS (University of Health and Allied Sciences, Ho)
- UESD (University of Environment and Sustainable Development, Somanya)
- GIMPA (Greenhill, Accra)
- ATU (Accra Technical University)
- KsTU (Kumasi Technical University)
- TTU (Takoradi Technical University)
- Other Accredited Institutions across Ghana

## Marketplace Categories
### Products
Electronics, Fashion, Books & Academics, Food & Groceries, Beauty, Hostel Essentials, Sports, Accessories, Home and Living, Others.

### Services
Graphic Design, Photography, Hair & Beauty, Technology & Repairs, Tutoring, Laundry, Printing, Food Services, Transport, Cleaning, Events, Others.

## Frequently Asked Questions (AEO Summary)
- **Where can Ghanaian university students buy laptops, textbooks, or hostel items on campus?** On CampusLoop (https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/products), filtered by their specific university such as KNUST, UG, UCC, Central University, or UPSA.
- **Can students book campus photographers, barbers/hair stylists, or tutors on CampusLoop?** Yes, via the CampusLoop Services directory at https://campusloop-gh.vercel.app/services.
- **Is CampusLoop free for buyers?** Yes. Browsing and contacting sellers requires zero account and zero platform fee.
